name: Poor
summary: Barely a coin. It is only just recognisable as one of its kind.
cent: Worn nearly flat. You can tell it is a cent by size and colour, and perhaps make out a rough head. The date may be gone.
quarter: Worn nearly flat. The size and silver edge say quarter, the face is a smooth blob, and the date may be missing.

name: Fair
summary: Worn almost smooth, but a little more of the design survives.
cent: Lincoln is a shape with no detail. The rim is worn down into the lettering, and the date might still be readable.
quarter: Washington is a vague outline and the eagle is a lump. Some letters around the edge are still there.

name: About Good
summary: Heavily worn, but the main outline is clear and the date can be read.
cent: Lincoln's head is an outline with no hair or ear detail. The date shows. Most of the lettering is flat against the rim.
quarter: Washington's head is an outline with no hair. The eagle is a rough shape. The date and a few letters can be read.

name: Good
summary: Very worn, with the main outline plain and the rim merging into the lettering.
cent: Lincoln's head and shoulders are an outline with a hint of hair. The date is clear. On the back, the Lincoln Memorial is a flat block.
quarter: The portrait is an outline with a smooth face. The eagle on the back is a rough shape, and the wreath is a line.

name: Good
summary: A little more detail than Good. The rim is clearer and the letters are separate again.
cent: The rim is complete. Lincoln's ear is a smudge and the letters are all there, though weak. The columns on the back are not yet separate.
quarter: The rim stands apart from the lettering. Hair is faintly shown above the ear, and the eagle's shape is better but has no feathers.

name: Very Good
summary: Worn, but the main parts of the design are clear and some detail shows.
cent: Lincoln's hair and beard show as lumps, with the ear faint. On the back, the pillars of the Memorial begin to show.
quarter: The hair has some lines, and the cheek is smooth. The eagle shows a few lines of wings, and the wreath leaves are partly visible.

name: Very Good
summary: Worn but nicely readable, with more detail than a Very Good 8.
cent: The beard and hair have clearer lines. Most of the Memorial's columns show, though the steps are flat.
quarter: Some hair lines show above the ear and the eagle has a few separate feathers. Most of the wreath is visible.

name: Fine
summary: Moderately worn, with all the main features clear and the high points flat.
cent: Lincoln's hair, ear and bow tie are clear with some detail. The Memorial's columns are clear and the steps are starting to show.
quarter: The hair has lines, and the eagle has most of its wing feathers. The cheek and the ribbon behind the neck are worn flat.

name: Fine
summary: A clear, honest circulated coin, with most detail present even if worn at the high points.
cent: The cheekbone and jaw are smooth, but hair and beard lines are mostly clear. The steps of the Memorial can be counted.
quarter: The hair above the ear is mostly clear. The eagle's breast feathers are partly gone, and the wreath is well defined.

name: Very Fine
summary: Light-to-moderate wear. All the major details are clear, with wear on the highest points.
cent: The hair is well defined, but the cheek, jaw and ear are flat. The Memorial's columns and steps are visible.
quarter: Most hair lines are clear and the cheek is worn. The eagle shows most of its feathers, with the breast and legs worn.

name: Very Fine
summary: Light wear on the high points, with sharp detail elsewhere.
cent: Hair detail stays strong with just the top of the head and cheek worn. The Memorial's columns are clear.
quarter: The hair above the ear is clear, with wear on the top of the head. The eagle's breast feathers show well.

name: Very Fine
summary: Light wear, usually on a few high points, with most detail sharp.
cent: Most hair and beard lines are sharp. The cheek and jaw show smooth wear.
quarter: The hair is sharp, with a worn spot at the cheek. The eagle's feathers are mostly sharp, with the tops of the legs worn.

name: Very Fine
summary: Only light wear on the very highest points. A good-looking coin.
cent: The coin looks bright and detailed. The cheekbone and hair above the ear show light wear and very little else is worn.
quarter: The portrait shows just a touch of wear on the cheek and the hair. The eagle's breast has all its feathers with slight flatness.

name: Extremely Fine
summary: Lightly worn, with sharp detail everywhere and a little flatness on the highest points.
cent: Hair, beard and ear are sharp. Only the cheek, jaw and top of the hair are lightly worn. Some mint shine may still sit in the recesses.
quarter: The hair and the eagle are sharp, with light wear at the cheek, the hair above the ear and the tops of the eagle's legs.

name: Extremely Fine
summary: Very light wear on only the highest points, with some original shine remaining.
cent: Wear shows only on the cheek and top of the head, with a bit of the original colour or shine in the protected areas.
quarter: A trace of wear on the cheek, the hair and the eagle's breast. Mint shine fills the recesses.

name: About Uncirculated
summary: Just a trace of wear on the highest points; most of the original shine is still there.
cent: Friction on the cheek and hair, with luster over most of the surface. The wear is easy to see only when you tilt it in the light.
quarter: Wear on the cheek, hair and the eagle's breast, no deeper than a light rub. Most of the shine remains.

name: About Uncirculated
summary: A little less wear than an AU-50, with more shine.
cent: Slight wear on the highest points, but more than half the original luster remains and the colour is bright.
quarter: Slight friction on the cheek and the eagle's breast. More than half of the luster is still in place.

name: About Uncirculated
summary: Slight wear that is hard to find, with most of the luster intact.
cent: Only a hint of wear on the cheek and hair. Luster covers most of the surface, with a few rub marks.
quarter: Wear is hard to see on the cheek and the eagle. Luster is full, with one or two small marks.

name: About Uncirculated
summary: Barely touched. It looks new unless you hunt for wear.
cent: Looks like a new coin with the barest friction on the very highest point of the cheek. Full luster.
quarter: Looks new, with a hint of friction on the cheek or the eagle's breast. Full luster.

name: Mint State
summary: Never circulated, but weak. It may be dull, scratched or heavily marked from bags.
cent: No wear, but it may have many scratches, spots or a dull surface. Lots of marks, possibly a bad strike.
quarter: No wear on the high points, but the surface has many scratches and dents from other coins. It may be dull.

name: Mint State
summary: Uncirculated, with many marks, but a little better than 60.
cent: No wear, but with many marks and a dull or uneven look.
quarter: No wear. Several marks on the cheek and face, though it is clearly new.

name: Mint State
summary: Uncirculated, with a number of marks and a mostly decent shine.
cent: No wear. Many small marks are easy to spot, and the shine may be uneven.
quarter: No wear. A number of marks are easy to see, but the shine is fairly good.

name: Mint State
summary: Uncirculated, with some marks and an acceptable shine and strike.
cent: No wear. Several small marks, none large, and good shine. The colour may be red-brown or brown.
quarter: No wear and good shine. Several small marks, probably a few on the face, and none that are large.

name: Mint State
summary: Uncirculated with a handful of small marks and a good strike.
cent: No wear. A few small marks away from the focal point, a clean look, and good colour.
quarter: No wear. A few small marks, none on the face or in the open fields, and a sharp strike.

name: Mint State
summary: A fine, sharp coin with a lively shine and just a few tiny marks.
cent: Full shine and a sharp strike with only a couple of small, hard-to-see marks. Bright red colour is common here.
quarter: Strong, lively shine and a sharp strike with only a couple of small marks, none on the face.

name: Mint State
summary: A very fine coin with a strong shine and only tiny, scattered marks.
cent: Excellent shine and strike with only minor flaws. Very few marks, even under a glass.
quarter: Excellent shine, a sharp strike and only minor marks, none in the main design.

name: Mint State
summary: Superb. Almost no marks, a brilliant shine and a sharp strike.
cent: Brilliant and clean. It takes a glass to find any marks at all.
quarter: Brilliant, with almost no marks and a sharp strike. You need a glass to find anything.

name: Mint State
summary: Nearly flawless, with a tiny flaw at most.
cent: Flawless to the eye with a very tiny flaw if any, and a perfect strike.
quarter: Flawless to the eye with an extraordinary strike and shine.

name: Mint State
summary: Almost perfect. Even under a glass you may find only one tiny flaw.
cent: Extremely rare and nearly perfect. A glass will find one tiny flaw at most.
quarter: Nearly perfect. A glass will show at most one tiny flaw.

name: Mint State
summary: Perfect in every way a grader can check: no flaw even under a glass.
cent: Perfect. No marks, a full strike, great shine and colour. Seen under magnification, there is nothing wrong.
quarter: Perfect. No marks, full strike, great shine. Nothing wrong under magnification.
